items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Terminology 13:1
items.html: The lower third of SAG of Atzilut receives from the discernment corresponding to it in AK, from the lower third of SAG of AK, where the GAR of Nekudim are, and where all the corrections of the association of the quality of mercy with judgment were rooted — that is, the discernment of the correction of the lines, and the ten vessels, and the discernment of the coupling upon ZON, which the Yesod of AK imparted there, in the secret of a Vav and a point, and so forth. Therefore the beginning of the coming into being of ZON of Atzilut is only through the mingling of their MAN in the belly of SAG, meaning in the lower third of her Tifferet, where all the corrections that are required for ZON were rooted. And on this account the lower third of the Tifferet of Ima is called by the name belly. (Page 544, Item 147).
